Types of Scholarship
Internal Scholarships
Category
Information
Research Assistant(RA) Scholarship
Full waiver of tuition and scholarship for one student per semester per professor
Professor Lim Giljin Memorial Scholarship
Full waiver of tuition for one student per semester
Tuition Waiver Scholarship
Scholarship for student with a grade point average of 3.3 in each department (in consideration of household income)
Alumni Association Scholarship
Scholarship for student with the highest grade point average in each department (3 from Department of Environmental Planning and 1 from Department of Environmental Landscape Architecture)
Executive Policy Program Scholarship
Scholarship for student selected from project competition each semester by Executive Policy Program Alumni Association
Overseas Student Scholarship
Overseas student and overseas student with Korean heritage with a grade point average of 3.3 or higher in the prior semester, as selected from the pool of candidates recommended by the External Affairs Office
Transportation Major Alumni Scholarship
Scholarship for one student majoring in Transportation
Environmental Management Major Alumni Scholarship
Scholarship for two students majoring in Environmental Management with exceptional performance in publication
GSES-MYSC Fellowship Scholarship
Scholarship for one student majoring in Social Inovation
External Scholarships
Category
Information
Development Fund Special Scholarship
Full tuition waiver scholarship from Seoul National University Development Fund (one student per semester)
National Scholarship for Science and Engineering Graduate Students
Scholarship for science and engineering graduate students by National Research Foundation (small number of students per semester)
Application for Scholarship
Application Period
Spring Semester : Mid-November of previous academic year
Fall Semester : Mid-June of current academic year
※ Application period will be announced in academic schedule each year and included in the announcement of application
Application Method
Apply via internet within a designated period of time
※ Application period will be announced in academic schedule each year and included in the announcement of application
